test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘WHILE’ is written as ‘2167103’ and ‘DEPTH’ is written as ‘2314186’. How will ‘ROUND’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

The logic followed here is,

**‘WHILE’ is written as ‘2167103’,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4066dc0fec070ba5bbd67d0cd0c380e685a3076424de8b0b8f409a69399fc43d.png] 

**‘DEPTH’ is written as ‘2314186’,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/531c1c04950205a9ebb3f203517b8e84ed45edd236ecf8577b2d52c6efc3a8cd.png] 

Similarly,

**'ROUND' can be written as,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76ce70d8d5d122b5223f62395941b76656b707ce37291c370829ae61140a0bd.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****161319122"**.
